full_judgment:
Mohammad Gholam Rabbani J: This appeal is directed against the judgment and decree dated 20-12-83 passed by the learned Subordinate Judge, Nilphamari, in Money Suit No. 3 of 1982. The suit was filed by the respondent Ekramul Haque, in fact, against Bangladesh Railway. The suit has been decreed against Bangladesh Railway Hence this appeal. 

 9. Now we come to the merit of the suit, DW 1 Talukder Nurul Amin is the only witness adduced on behalf of the defendants. DW 1 deposed that he was Divisional Engineer (Bridge) during the period in question. Defendants resisted the claim of the plaintiff on the ground that the previous measurement of earth work which was 780361 Cft was found to be wrong after remeasurement by the DW 1. But DW 1 in his cross examination admitted that he did not notify the plaintiff before the remeasurement. It was suggested to the DW 1 in his cross-examination that Additional Chief Engineer (Bridge) demanded illegal gratification from the plaintiff who refused to the demand and so the Additional Chief Engineer(Bridge) stopped the payment. DW 1 however, denied the suggestion. We have scrutinised the entire deposition of DW 1 and found that the deposition must be considered with a grain of salt. We therefore, find that the trial Court legally and rightly decreed the suit. 

 This appeal, is therefore, dismissed without costs. Decree of the trial Court, however, is modified to the extent that the suit stands decreed without costs. Connected Civil Rule is discharged without costs.
